notes: Flow interrogation log: captures the rationale for each trade (exit/entry/trim) — populated by interactive runs asking 'why' and by scheduled runs writing 'UNCAPTURED' for manual review. Each entry: {date, ticker, action ('exit'|'trim'|'entry'), qty_change, price_at_trade, reason ('dollar-cost-averaging'|'dca-into-diversification'|'re-entry-after-stop'|'stop-loss'|'thesis-change'|'raise-cash'|'rebalance'|UNCAPTURED, or free text if the user typed something not on that list), notes}. Step 1 is direction-aware (same day, user request): a buy (qty_diff > 0) is asked 'was this DCA?' first, a sell (qty_diff < 0) is asked 'was this a stop-loss?' first; step 2 shows whichever 4 of the 5 reasons step 1 didn't already rule out. | 2026-08-03: 'dca-into-diversification' and 're-entry-after-stop' promoted to standing buy-side reasons (see G45) after both recurred via 'Other' the same day — a same-day MU stop-loss/rebuy whipsaw pair (re-entry-after-stop) and a five-ticker weekend diversification buy the user confirmed as DCA into diversification.
